edit.description: keepsExclusionsOf requires only the base exclusions the relocation's templates still reach
export templateMatches / templateReachesBeneath for the reach test
a moved relocation beside its base replaces it; one dropping a still-reached exclusion refuses

summary: A relocation that moves its locus and drops base exclusions its new templates no longer reach replaces its built-in instead of refusing as a third kind
acceptance: A memory relocation to a root its built-in exclusions fall outside, in play beside a member built from built-in memory, resolves to the relocation; a value dropping an exclusion its templates still reach still refuses
notes: From the EXCLUDING-RELOCATION-REPLACES-ITS-BUILT-IN build note: relocatedLocus (kind.ts) drops unreached exclusions, but the subset check demands all of them. Its two behaviors are SDK tests in sdk/test/builtins.test.ts, held by the SDK gate (PROTOCOL, Tests, question 2), so the entry names no tests[] line.
